meta.title: QC Approval Workflow: not available on the Growth plan
gaps: Open or use the QC Approval Workflow
Enter inspection results and configure or evaluate a risk threshold
Verify that exceeding the threshold requires quality sign-off
Compare the same Quality Manager workflow between Growth and Enterprise tenants
Verify plan-based refusal or absence using the tenant's Growth and Enterprise plan configuration
warnings: can only test part of this — no step for: Open or use the QC Approval Workflow; Enter inspection results and configure or evaluate a risk threshold; Verify that exceeding the threshold requires quality sign-off; Compare the same Quality Manager workflow between Growth and Enterprise tenants; Verify plan-based refusal or absence using the tenant's Growth and Enterprise plan configuration

args.need: sign in as the Quality Manager on the Growth and Enterprise tenants, run QC Approval Workflow with inspection results above the risk threshold, and verify that Growth is refused or absent while Enterprise permits the workflow and requires sign-off

steps.note: The catalog cannot access the QC workflow or switch tenants by plan, so the tester must perform the complete cross-plan comparison.
Check that the tester's final screen exposes the named workflow, if available; this is only a minimal observation and does not establish plan-gating behavior.
